method.discovery: Recorded research queries per site; only /watch?v= results carried forward, so Shorts and vertical clips never enter the pool.
method.verification: YouTube public oEmbed endpoint (no API key, no scraping). A 404 drops the candidate as private, removed or blocked.
method.quality: Thumbnail CDN rendition probe. maxresdefault.jpg exists only for uploads of 1280x720 or better.
method.scoring: relevance 30 / visual 20 / identification 20 / credibility 15 / licence-embed 5 / HD bonus 5. Recency and audio quality are withheld, not guessed.
method.gate: A candidate must name the monastery in its own title, describe it as the religious site rather than the village of the same name, not name a confusable neighbouring institution, carry no disqualifying region token, and score at least 0.7.
method.embedding: youtube-nocookie.com embed, click-to-load, never autoplayed with sound, never downloaded or re-hosted.
